name: Machine Hammer Preacher Curl
steps: Adjust the preacher seat so your elbows line up with the machine pivot and your upper arms rest on the pad.
Take the handles with your thumbs up and settle your chest against the pad edge.
Curl the handles smoothly upward toward your shoulders while maintaining a neutral thumb-up wrist position.
Lower the handles slowly back to near full arm extension without dropping the stack.
tips: Keep your elbows pressed steadily into the pad rather than leaning back to start each repetition.
Avoid bending your wrists inward at the top of the curl.
